reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles and I don't take a supplement unless a doctor tells me to. The named lab and the batch report are more than most brands give, but I'd still be spending $25 on something I have no reason to think I need.
objection: Nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium, so even a tested product is just another bottle I stop taking after a week.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me I'm low on magnesium and to take it, plus a smaller first box (like a 7-day trial) for a few dollars.
